title: israeli-banks-simplefin-bridge configuration
description: config.json for israeli-banks-simplefin-bridge. Credential values may be literal strings or op://<vault>/<item>/<field> references resolved through 1Password Connect.

schedule.description: Cron expression for scheduled scrapes (5 fields, evaluated in `timezone`). Omit for one-shot mode via the CLI. The SCHEDULE env var overrides it.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for calendar dates. Default Asia/Jerusalem.

currency.description: Default account currency (ISO-4217) when a scraper does not say. Default ILS.

staleHours.description: /healthz returns 503 when an enabled company has no successful scrape within this many hours. Default 30.

overlapDays.description: Days re-scraped on every run to catch late postings (window starts at lastSuccess - overlapDays). Default 30.

maxLoginAttemptsPerDay.description: Max login attempts per company per calendar day (bank lockout guard). Default 2.

enabled.description: Disabled companies are never scraped and never served. Default true.

label.description: Human label used for SimpleFIN connection/account names and logs.

kind.description: Default kind for every account of this company (checking, credit_card, savings, investment).

credentials.description: Credential fields exactly as israeli-bank-scrapers expects them (userCode/password, username/password, id/card6Digits/password, ...). Values may be literal strings or op://<vault>/<item>/<field> references.

accounts.description: Scraper accountNumber filter: "all" or a list of account numbers. Default "all".

startDate.description: Lower bound for scraping, YYYY-MM-DD. Each scraper clamps to its own max lookback.

additionalTransactionInformation.description: israeli-bank-scrapers option; slower, more bot-detection exposure, may change identifiers for some banks. Default false.

includePending.description: Serve pending rows to consumers. Default false (pending ids are unstable for several companies).

futureMonthsToScrape.description: israeli-bank-scrapers option (credit cards): how many future billing months to scrape.

dateMode.description: Which date becomes the row date: purchase/event date ("purchase") or bank charge/billing date ("charge"). Default purchase.

chargeDay.description: Credit cards only: day of month the bank account is debited for the bill. Used for documentation and synthetic payments.

synthesizePayments.description: Credit cards only, opt-in: emit one synthetic positive "card payment" row per charge date. Default false.

timeoutMinutes.description: Wall-clock limit for one scrape of this company, in minutes. Default 20.

scraperOptions.description: Extra israeli-bank-scrapers options passed through verbatim (e.g. optInFeatures, viewportSize).

companies.description: One entry per bank/card company, keyed by the israeli-bank-scrapers company id.

enabled.description: Enable the investment feed and independent collector. Default false.

readToken.description: Dedicated investment read bearer token or op:// reference. Missing or unavailable token disables only the investment feed.

credentials.description: Clal Israeli ID and phone, preferably op:// references resolved by 1Password Connect.

schedule.description: Independent collection cron in the bridge timezone. Default 0 7 * * 1 (weekly Monday at 07:00).

staleHours.description: Age after which investment data is stale. Default 192 hours.

timeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time allowed for one collection. Default 10 minutes.

sessionKeepAliveMinutes.description: Optional native session renewal interval, 1–10 minutes; 0 disables it (default). Never requests SMS or refreshes financial-data timestamps.

googleMessagesOtpSocket.description: Optional absolute Google Messages OTP Unix socket. Omission disables automatic recovery. Limited to two SMS requests per rolling 24 hours.

investments.description: Optional dedicated Clal investment collection and feed, separate from SimpleFIN bank accounts.

publicUrl.description: Base URL consumers use to reach this bridge, no trailing slash. Default http://israeli-banks-bridge:8080.

claimTtlMinutes.description: Setup tokens expire this many minutes after minting. Default 15.

maxClaims.description: A setup token may be claimed at most this many times (until the first successful authenticated GET). Default 3.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.
